channel.title: Game Night Guide
channel.description: Plain-English board game guides for the USA: what to buy first, what plays well with two people, and what works for a family game night. No jargon, no hype. Players, time, age and price, checked.

item.title: Best Board Games for 2 Players Under $40
item.description: The best board games for 2 players under $40: games made for two, not games that just allow two. Patchwork, Jaipur, 7 Wonders Duel, Sky Team and more.

item.title: Best Board Games for Beginners
item.description: The best board games for beginners: ten gateway games you can teach in under ten minutes and finish in under an hour. Ticket to Ride, Codenames, Azul, Carcassonne and more.

item.title: Best Board Games for Couples
item.description: The best board games for two people: date-night picks that are actually good with two, not games that just tolerate two players. Patchwork, Jaipur, 7 Wonders Duel and more.

item.title: Best Board Games Under $30
item.description: How to buy a good board game for under $30: small-box games, what to check before you pay, and the budget picks that are actually worth it.

item.title: Best Solo Board Games for Beginners
item.description: The best solo board games for beginners: gentle, affordable solo games to start with, and the expensive epics to leave for later. Cascadia, Friday, and what solo play is really like.

item.title: Ticket to Ride vs Catan
item.description: Ticket to Ride vs Catan: which first board game should you buy? Players, time, age, difficulty and who each game is actually for, compared side by side.
